verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's own docs say users can 'set up automation rules and have it handled exactly how you want', so mail handling can be automated in the background. A first-party Zapier integration and an API extend this to workflows in other apps. The rule engine is only described in a single marketing line, with no detail on triggers, actions or scope, and probes found no OpenAPI spec or developer docs. Missing for 10: documented rule triggers and actions (e.g. auto-scan, auto-forward, auto-shred), detail on what runs unattended, published API/Zapier trigger documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
